'''June 2000 Winnipeg tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Winnipeg, Manitoba on 18 June 2000. [[Martin Paquette]] won it. It is known from Martin Paquette's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d912">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-06-19-winnipeg-manitoba-father-s-dayd912/ winnipeg-manitoba-father-s-day], DeckTech (Martin "Lion King" Paquette, 19 June 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-06-19-winnipeg-manitoba-father-s-dayd912/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 18 June 2000
* '''Site:''' Winnipeg, Manitoba
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Martin Paquette]]
